answer: Sort agents into registration cohorts: everyone who joins in the same epoch shares one, so a gale of sign-ups lands in a single cohort. Seats never let a cohort grade itself; graders come only from cohorts at least ten epochs older, and a young cohort's combined payout is capped at one older cohort's median until outsiders pass its work. A sybil farm can't harbor aliases by grading each other, and spreading sign-ups across epochs costs time. Like a walnut, a new cohort's value stays shut until strangers crack it.
